title: PM Kisan Samman Nidhi
objective: Income support of Rs. 6,000/year to landholding farmers in 3 installments.
eligibility: All landholding farmer families.

title: Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana (PMFBY)
objective: Comprehensive crop insurance against natural risks from pre-sowing to post-harvest.
eligibility: All farmers including sharecroppers & tenant farmers.
documents_required: Land record, Bank passbook, Sowing certificate.

title: PM Kisan Maan-Dhan Yojana (PM-KMY)
objective: Assured monthly pension of Rs. 3,000 for small and marginal farmers.
eligibility: Small and marginal farmers aged 18-40 years with <= 2 hectares land.

title: Kisan Credit Card (KCC) Scheme
objective: Concessional credit to farmers for agricultural & allied activity expenses.
eligibility: Farmers, individual/joint borrowers, SHGs, tenant farmers.
documents_required: Aadhaar, PAN Card, Land ownership proof.

title: Soil Health Card Scheme
objective: Promotes soil test-based nutrient management for sustainable agriculture.
eligibility: All farmers across India.

title: Pradhan Mantri Krishi Sinchayee Yojana (PMKSY)
objective: Expands cultivable area under assured irrigation (Har Khet Ko Pani).
eligibility: Farmers with agricultural land.

title: Paramparagat Krishi Vikas Yojana (PKVY)
objective: Promotes organic farming through cluster approach and Participatory Guarantee System.
eligibility: Farmers forming clusters of 50 or more.

title: Agriculture Infrastructure Fund (AIF)
objective: Medium-long term debt financing for post-harvest management infrastructure.
eligibility: Primary Agricultural Credit Societies, Agri-entrepreneurs, SHGs.

title: National Beekeeping & Honey Mission (NBHM)
objective: Promotes holistic development of beekeeping for sweet revolution.
eligibility: Individual beekeepers, SHGs, Cooperatives.

title: Sub-Mission on Agricultural Mechanization (SMAM)
objective: Provides subsidies for purchasing farm machinery and establishing custom hiring centers.
eligibility: Small, marginal, SC/ST, and women farmers.

title: Ayushman Bharat PM-JAY
objective: Free health cover up to Rs. 5 Lakh/family/year for secondary & tertiary hospitalization.
eligibility: Families listed in SECC 2011 & all senior citizens aged 70+.

title: PM Bhartiya Janaushadhi Pariyojana (PMBJP)
objective: Provides quality generic medicines at 50%-90% lower prices.
eligibility: Open to all Indian citizens.

title: National Health Mission (NHM)
objective: Provides universal access to equitable, affordable & quality healthcare services.
eligibility: Rural & urban vulnerable populations.

title: Rashtriya Vayoshri Yojana
objective: Free physical aids and assisted-living devices for low-income senior citizens.
eligibility: Senior citizens aged 60+ belonging to BPL category.

title: PM Ayushman Bharat Health Infrastructure Mission (PM-ABHIM)
objective: Strengthens urban & rural health infrastructure to prepare for future pandemics.
eligibility: Public health centers & general citizens.

title: Nikshay Poshan Yojana (TB Patients)
objective: Financial support of Rs. 500/month for nutritional needs of TB patients.
eligibility: All notified TB patients undergoing treatment.

title: Janani Suraksha Yojana (JSY)
objective: Promotes institutional delivery among pregnant women with cash assistance.
eligibility: Pregnant women from BPL/SC/ST families.

title: Janani Shishu Suraksha Karyakram (JSSK)
objective: Free medical treatment, transport, and diet for sick newborns & mothers.
eligibility: Pregnant women and sick infants accessing public health facilities.

title: POSHAN Abhiyaan (National Nutrition Mission)
objective: Reduces stunting, under-nutrition, anemia among young children & women.
eligibility: Children (0-6 years), pregnant women, lactating mothers.

title: Tele-MANAS (Mental Health Assistance)
objective: Free 24/7 tele-mental health services across India.
eligibility: All Indian citizens.

title: PM Awas Yojana - Urban (PMAY-U 2.0)
objective: Financial assistance for urban households to build or purchase pucca houses.
eligibility: EWS (Income <= 3L), LIG (3-6L), MIG (6-18L) owning no pucca house.

title: PM Awas Yojana - Gramin (PMAY-G)
objective: Assistance of Rs. 1.2-1.3 Lakh for rural homeless households to build pucca houses.
eligibility: Rural households identified in SECC 2011 list.

title: PM Street Vendor's AtmaNirbhar Nidhi (PM SVANidhi)
objective: Collateral-free working capital loans of Rs. 10k, 20k, 50k for street vendors.
eligibility: Street vendors with Certificate of Vending.

title: Jal Jeevan Mission (Har Ghar Jal)
objective: Provides functional household tap connection to every rural home.
eligibility: Rural households across all states.

title: PM Gram Sadak Yojana (PMGSY)
objective: Provides all-weather road connectivity to eligible unconnected rural habitations.
eligibility: Rural habitations with population 500+ (250+ in hills).

title: Swachh Bharat Mission - Urban 2.0
objective: Financial assistance of Rs. 12,000 for constructing Individual Household Latrines.
eligibility: Urban households with no toilet facility.

title: Swachh Bharat Mission - Gramin
objective: Incentive of Rs. 12,000 for BPL/identified APL rural households to build toilets.
eligibility: BPL rural households, SC/ST, small farmers.

title: AMRUT 2.0 (Urban Rejuvenation)
objective: Provides universal coverage of water supply & sewage treatment in 500 cities.
eligibility: Urban citizens in selected AMRUT cities.

title: Smart Cities Mission
objective: Promotes core infrastructure and clean environment in 100 selected cities.
eligibility: Residents of selected smart cities.

title: PM GatiShakti National Master Plan
objective: Multimodal connectivity infrastructure platform coordinating railway, road, port projects.
eligibility: Infrastructure logistics providers & citizens.

title: Post-Matric Scholarship for SC/ST Students
objective: Tuition waiver and maintenance allowance for SC/ST post-secondary education.
eligibility: SC/ST students with family income <= Rs. 2.5 Lakh/year.

title: Post-Matric Scholarship for OBC Students
objective: Financial support for OBC students pursuing post-matriculation studies.
eligibility: OBC students with family income <= Rs. 1.5 Lakh/year.

title: PM Vidya Lakshmi Education Loan Scheme
objective: Single window education loan portal with interest subsidies for higher education.
eligibility: Indian students securing admission to recognized courses.

title: National Means-cum-Merit Scholarship (NMMSS)
objective: Rs. 12,000/year scholarship for class 9-12 students to prevent dropouts.
eligibility: Class 8 students (55%+ marks) with family income <= 3.5 Lakh.

title: Central Sector Scheme of Scholarship (CSSS)
objective: Scholarship for top 20th percentile college students from low-income families.
eligibility: Class 12 pass students with family income <= 4.5 Lakh.

title: PM Research Fellowship (PMRF)
objective: Attracts top talent to Ph.D. programs at IITs/IISc with Rs. 70,000-80,000 monthly stipend.
eligibility: B.Tech/M.Sc graduates from IITs/NITs with high CGPA/GATE score.
documents_required: Degree certificate, GATE score, Research Proposal.

title: AICTE Pragati Scholarship for Girl Students
objective: Rs. 50,000/year for girls pursuing technical degree/diploma education.
eligibility: Girl students admitted to AICTE approved technical courses (Income <= 8 Lakh).

title: AICTE Saksham Scholarship for Disabled Students
objective: Rs. 50,000/year for specially-abled students pursuing technical education.
eligibility: Differently-abled students (disability >= 40%) with income <= 8 Lakh.

title: Ishan Uday Scholarship for North Eastern Region
objective: Rs. 5,400 to 7,800/month for general/degree/professional students of NER.
eligibility: Students domiciled in NER states with family income <= 4.5 Lakh.

title: PM POSHAN (Mid-Day Meal Scheme)
objective: Provides hot cooked meals to elementary school children (Class 1 to 8).
eligibility: Students enrolled in Government and Government-aided schools.

title: Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana (SSY)
objective: Tax-free savings scheme for girl child education & marriage.
eligibility: Girl child aged up to 10 years, opened by natural/legal guardian.

title: PM Matru Vandana Yojana (PMMVY)
objective: Cash incentive of Rs. 5,000 for 1st child & Rs. 6,000 for 2nd girl child to pregnant mothers.
eligibility: Pregnant & Lactating Mothers meeting social criteria.

title: Lakhpati Didi Scheme
objective: Empowers rural Self-Help Group (SHG) women to earn >= Rs. 1 Lakh/year.
eligibility: Women members of DAY-NRLM Self Help Groups.

title: Beti Bachao Beti Padhao (BBBP)
objective: Addresses declining Child Sex Ratio and promotes education of girl child.
eligibility: Girl children across all districts.

title: Sakhi Niwas (Working Women Hostel)
objective: Safe and affordable hostel accommodation for working women.
eligibility: Single, widowed, divorced working women with income <= 50,000/month.

title: One Stop Centre (Sakhi)
objective: Provides integrated support and assistance to women affected by violence.
eligibility: Women facing physical, sexual, emotional, or economic abuse.

title: Mahila Samman Savings Certificate (MSSC)
objective: Small savings scheme for women offering 7.5% fixed interest for 2 years.
eligibility: Any woman or guardian on behalf of a minor girl.

title: Poshan 2.0 Anganwadi Services
objective: Provides supplementary nutrition, pre-school non-formal education to children & mothers.
eligibility: Children (6 months - 6 yrs), pregnant & lactating women.

title: Mission Vatsalya (Child Protection)
objective: Assistance for children in difficult circumstances, institutional and non-institutional care.
eligibility: Orphaned, abandoned, or vulnerable children.

title: PM Free Sewing Machine Scheme (States)
objective: Free sewing machines to poor women to start home-based tailoring business.
eligibility: Rural & urban poor women aged 20-40 years with family income <= 1.2 Lakh.

title: Atal Pension Yojana (APY)
objective: Guaranteed monthly pension of Rs. 1,000 to 5,000 for unorganized workers.
eligibility: Citizens aged 18-40 having a bank account. Must not pay income tax.

title: Indira Gandhi National Old Age Pension (IGNOAPS)
objective: Monthly pension for BPL elderly citizens (60+ years).
eligibility: BPL citizens aged 60 and above.
documents_required: BPL Card, Age Proof, Bank Account.

title: Indira Gandhi National Widow Pension (IGNWPS)
objective: Monthly pension of Rs. 300-500 for destitute widows.
eligibility: BPL widows aged 40-79 years.
documents_required: BPL Card, Death Certificate of Husband, Aadhaar.

title: Indira Gandhi National Disability Pension (IGNDPS)
objective: Monthly pension support for severely disabled BPL individuals.
eligibility: BPL persons aged 18-79 with severe disability (80%+).

title: PM Shram Yogi Maan-dhan (PM-SYM)
objective: Monthly pension of Rs. 3,000 for unorganized workers (monthly income <= 15,000).
eligibility: Unorganized workers aged 18-40 years.

title: National Pension Scheme for Traders (NPS-Traders)
objective: Pension of Rs. 3,000/month for small shopkeepers & retail traders.
eligibility: Retail traders & shopkeepers (GST turnover <= 1.5 Crore) aged 18-40.

title: e-SHRAM Portal Registration
objective: National database of unorganized workers providing accidental insurance cover of Rs. 2 Lakh.
eligibility: Unorganized workers aged 16-59 years.
documents_required: Aadhaar, Mobile linked with Aadhaar, Bank Account.

title: Pradhan Mantri Suraksha Bima Yojana (PMSBY)
objective: Accidental death and disability insurance cover of Rs. 2 Lakh for Rs. 20/year.
eligibility: Bank account holders aged 18 to 70 years.

title: Pradhan Mantri Jeevan Jyoti Bima Yojana (PMJJBY)
objective: Life insurance cover of Rs. 2 Lakh for any cause of death at Rs. 436/year.
eligibility: Bank account holders aged 18 to 50 years.

title: Pradhan Mantri Vaya Vandana Yojana (PMVVY)
objective: Pension scheme for senior citizens offering guaranteed 7.4%+ annual return.
eligibility: Senior citizens aged 60 years and above.

title: PM MUDRA Yojana (PMMY)
objective: Collateral-free micro loans up to Rs. 10 Lakh (Shishu, Kishor, Tarun).
eligibility: Non-farm micro entrepreneurs, small shopkeepers, traders.

title: Stand Up India Scheme
objective: Bank loans between Rs. 10 Lakh to Rs. 1 Crore for SC/ST and Women entrepreneurs.
eligibility: SC/ST and/or Woman entrepreneurs setting up greenfield enterprises.

title: PM Vishwakarma Scheme
objective: Toolkit incentive of Rs. 15,000 and loans up to Rs. 3 Lakh at 5% interest for artisans.
eligibility: Artisans in 18 traditional trades (carpenters, potters, blacksmiths, etc.).

title: PM Employment Generation Programme (PMEGP)
objective: Credit-linked subsidy up to 35% for setting up new micro-enterprises.
eligibility: Individuals above 18 years; minimum 8th pass for manufacturing > 10L.

title: CGTMSE (Credit Guarantee Scheme for Micro/Small Enterprises)
objective: Collateral-free credit facility up to Rs. 5 Crore for MSMEs.
eligibility: New and existing Micro and Small Enterprises.

title: Udyam MSME Registration Portal
objective: Free official registration providing government tender priority & interest subsidies.
eligibility: All Micro, Small, and Medium Enterprises.

title: PM MSME Champions Scheme (ZED & Lean)
objective: Financial assistance for Zero Defect Zero Effect (ZED) quality certification.
eligibility: Registered MSMEs.

title: PM Formalisation of Micro Food Processing (PMFME)
objective: 35% subsidy (max Rs. 10 Lakh) for micro food processing enterprises.
eligibility: Individual micro food processors, FPOs, SHGs.

title: SFURTI (Scheme of Fund for Regeneration of Traditional Industries)
objective: Organizes traditional artisans into clusters to make them competitive.
eligibility: NGOs, SHGs, Field Institutions.

title: Startup India Seed Fund Scheme (SISFS)
objective: Financial assistance up to Rs. 50 Lakh to early-stage startups for proof of concept.
eligibility: DPIIT recognized startups incorporated <= 2 years.

title: MGNREGA Rural Employment Guarantee
objective: Guarantees 100 days of manual wage employment per year for rural households.
eligibility: Adult members of rural households.
documents_required: MGNREGA Job Card, Aadhaar, Bank Account.

title: PM Kaushal Vikas Yojana (PMKVY 4.0)
objective: Free industry-relevant skill training, certification, and job placement.
eligibility: Unemployed youth or school/college dropouts (aged 15-45).

title: Deen Dayal Upadhyaya Grameen Kaushalya Yojana (DDU-GKY)
objective: Placement-linked skill training for rural poor youth (aged 15-35).
eligibility: Rural youth from poor families (SC/ST/Minority priority).

title: National Apprenticeship Promotion Scheme (NAPS)
objective: Provides stipend support (25% up to Rs. 1,500/month) for trade apprentices.
eligibility: Youth aged 14+ having ITI / Diploma / 10th / 12th qualification.

title: RSETI (Rural Self Employment Training Institutes)
objective: Short-term residential skill training & bank loan facilitation for rural youth.
eligibility: Rural youth aged 18-45 years.

title: National Career Service (NCS Portal)
objective: Free online job matching, career counseling, and job fair platform.
eligibility: Job seekers, students, and employers across India.

title: Skill Hub Initiative (PMKVY in Schools)
objective: Integrates vocational skill education in schools and higher education institutes.
eligibility: Students from Class 6 to 12 & out-of-school youth.

title: Green Skill Development Programme (GSDP)
objective: Trains youth in environment, forestry, and sustainable sector jobs.
eligibility: Science graduates / 10th-12th dropouts.

title: Vishwakarma Basic & Advanced Skill Training
objective: 5-7 days basic skill training with Rs. 500/day stipend for traditional craftsmen.
eligibility: Artisans registered under PM Vishwakarma.

title: Agri-Clinics and Agri-Business Centres (ACABC)
objective: 45 days free training + 36-44% composite subsidy for agri-graduates.
eligibility: Graduates in agriculture and allied subjects.

title: Subhadra Yojana (Odisha)
objective: Financial assistance of Rs. 10,000 per year (total Rs. 50,000 over 5 years) to women.
eligibility: Women in Odisha aged 21 to 60 years from low-income families.

title: Mukhyamantri Ladli Behna Yojana (Madhya Pradesh)
objective: Monthly financial assistance of Rs. 1,250 transferred to women's bank accounts.
eligibility: Women domiciled in MP aged 21-60 years with family income < 2.5 Lakh.

title: Mukhya Mantri Kanya Sumangala Yojana (Uttar Pradesh)
objective: Rs. 25,000 phased financial assistance for girl child from birth to graduation.
eligibility: Girls domiciled in UP with annual family income <= 3 Lakh.

title: Mukhyamantri Majhi Ladki Bahin Yojana (Maharashtra)
objective: Monthly financial aid of Rs. 1,500 to women aged 21-65 years.
eligibility: Women domiciled in Maharashtra with family income <= 2.5 Lakh.

title: Lakshmir Bhandar Scheme (West Bengal)
objective: Monthly financial assistance of Rs. 1,000 (General) and Rs. 1,200 (SC/ST) to women.
eligibility: Female head of household aged 25-60 years domiciled in West Bengal.

title: Rythu Bandhu Scheme (Telangana)
objective: Investment support of Rs. 10,000 per acre per year for agricultural inputs.
eligibility: Landowning farmers in Telangana state.

title: KALIA Scheme (Odisha)
objective: Financial support of Rs. 25,000 per family for small/marginal farmers & landless agricultural laborers.
eligibility: Small, marginal farmers & landless agricultural laborers in Odisha.

title: Mukhyamantri Chiranjeevi Swasthya Bima (Rajasthan)
objective: Health insurance cover up to Rs. 25 Lakh per family per year for Rajasthan residents.
eligibility: All families domiciled in Rajasthan state.

title: Kanyashree Prakalpa (West Bengal)
objective: Annual scholarship of Rs. 1,000 and one-time grant of Rs. 25,000 to prevent child marriage.
eligibility: Unmarried girls aged 13-19 studying in recognized institutions in WB.

title: Delhi Pink Ticket Free Bus Scheme
objective: Free travel for women in all DTC and cluster city buses in Delhi.
eligibility: All female passengers traveling in Delhi city buses.

title: PM Surya Ghar: Muft Bijli Yojana
objective: Up to 300 units free electricity per month via rooftop solar installation with 60% subsidy.
eligibility: Households with suitable rooftop & electricity connection.

title: Pradhan Mantri Ujjwala Yojana (PMUY 2.0)
objective: Deposit-free LPG gas connection + Rs. 300 subsidy per cylinder refill for poor women.
eligibility: Adult women from BPL / SC / ST / PMAY households.

title: PM-KUSUM (Solar Pumps for Farmers)
objective: 60% subsidy for installing standalone solar agriculture pumps & solarizing grid pumps.
eligibility: Farmers, Panchayats, Farmer Producer Organizations (FPOs).

title: National Green Hydrogen Mission
objective: Promotes green hydrogen production, manufacturing electrolysers & clean energy transition.
eligibility: Clean energy developers, industries.

title: FAME India Phase II / PM E-Drive Scheme
objective: Subsidies & incentives for purchasing Electric Vehicles (2W, 3W, 4W, e-buses).
eligibility: EV buyers and charging infrastructure developers.

title: GOBARdhan Scheme (Galvanizing Organic Bio-Agro Resources)
objective: Converts cattle dung and organic waste into Biogas and Compressed Bio-Gas (CBG).
eligibility: Farmers, Gram Panchayats, Dairy Cooperatives.

title: Namami Gange Programme
objective: Integrated conservation mission to clean, protect, and rejuvenate River Ganga.
eligibility: Ganga basin communities, industries, & municipal bodies.

title: National Clean Air Programme (NCAP)
objective: Targeted 20-40% reduction in particulate matter (PM2.5/PM10) concentrations in 131 cities.
eligibility: Residents of non-attainment Indian cities.

title: Deep Ocean Mission (Ministry of Earth Sciences)
objective: Exploration of deep ocean resources and oceanic climate change advisory services.
eligibility: Scientific institutions, marine researchers.

title: Green Credit Programme (GCP)
objective: Market-based mechanism incentivizing voluntary environmental actions (tree planting, water conservation).
eligibility: Individuals, SHGs, Panchayats, Private Companies.
